title_en: MHLW Ordinance Amending Ministry Ordinances Following Partial Enforcement of Infectious Diseases Act Amendments
title_ja: 感染症の予防及び感染症の患者に対する医療に関する法律等の一部を改正する法律の一部の施行に伴う厚生労働省関係省令の整備に関する省令
summary_en: This is a Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) ordinance amending related ministry ordinances in connection with the partial enforcement of a law amending the Act on Prevention of Infectious Diseases and Medical Care for Patients with Infectious Diseases and related statutes. According to the metadata, the affected ordinance is the Vaccination Enforcement Regulations (Ministry of Health and Welfare Ordinance No. 27 of 1958), and the amending ordinance is MHLW Ordinance No. 165 of 2022. The metadata lists both a promulgation date and an enforcement date of December 9, 2022.
business_impact_en: Organizations involved in vaccination administration or infectious disease medical care may be affected by changes to the referenced enforcement regulations.
recommended_action_en: Consider reviewing the official Japanese source on e-Gov to confirm the scope and details of the amended provisions.
source_name: e-Gov Law Search (法令更新一覧)
ai_notes: Based on the provided title and raw metadata; the metadata indicates both promulgation and enforcement on 2022-12-09, but the exact substantive changes are unverified. Stage and impact labels are keyword-based triage only.

business_impact_ja: 予防接種の実施に関わる事業者や医療機関において、関連する省令の内容確認や運用上の対応が必要となる可能性があります。
